Streamlines the creation of descriptive frequency tables ('Table 1'), diagnostic test accuracy evaluations (sensitivity, specificity, predictive values), and multi-outcome regression summaries. Features a grammar for publication-ready epidemiological tables built on design-aware effect measures, prevalence and odds ratio calculations, and seamless integration with 'flextable' for exporting results to 'Microsoft Word' and 'PowerPoint'.
